name: Exit Zone
detailed_description:
WARNING: This game contains visual and audio anomalies, disorienting effects, and psychological horror.

You wake up in a decaying zone where time loops and reality fractures. The lights flicker. The corridors repeat. Something is deeply wrong—and it's getting worse.

Exit Zone is a memory-based anomaly horror game inspired by Exit 8, designed for 1–5 players with full proximity voice chat. Every corridor looks the same—until it doesn’t.

How to Survive

Observe your surroundings. Memorize every room, object, sound, and corridor. Advance only when you're certain everything is normal—then pull the green lever.

If anything feels off, hit the red lever before it’s too late. Anomalies can be subtle… or dangerous.

One wrong choice, and the zone resets—or worse.

Gameplay Features

  • Anomaly Observation Mechanics
    Spot shifting elements in the environment: misplaced objects, altered text, warped visuals, impossible physics, or entities that shouldn’t exist.

  • Solo or Co-op Multiplayer (1–5 Players)
    Work together to share memory and identify anomalies—or split up and risk it alone.

  • Proximity Voice Chat
    Your microphone brings immersion. Talk to your team, but beware: your voice may attract something.

  • Randomized Runs
    Each playthrough generates new anomaly patterns, ensuring replayability and paranoia every time.

  • No Combat – Just Observation
    The only way out is to observe, remember, and choose the correct path.

What Makes Exit Zone Different?

  • True psychological tension – no cheap jumpscares.

  • A haunted world designed to sharpen your perception.

  • Anomalies escalate the longer you remain inside.

  • Every decision matters. Every second counts.

Do you remember where the door was? Are you sure that corpse wasn’t here before?

One wrong choice, and you’ll be part of the zone forever.

Welcome to Exit Zone.

short_description: Exit Zone is a multiplayer horror game with anomalies for 1–5 players. Use voice chat to communicate with your friends, memorize every corridor, uncover anomalies, and make the right decisions—before Exit Zone traps you forever.

English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Japanese*, Russian*, Turkish*, Ukrainian*, Simplified Chinese*, Czech*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950/Radeon R7 370 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game should work even on worse components than those listed.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4590 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060/Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
